acrRunNotes.cj3p: PR #21 (47eb0c6), the first PayPal sign-in rollout

paypalSignIn.app: SwarmPay, a PayPal sandbox app separate from both merchants' apps
paypalSignIn.applicationReceives: the public login client ID and its token for the identity service (swarm-pay-login-client)
paypalSignIn.agentRouteToPayPal: none: the commerce application's egress admits the identity service, not PayPal

callbackFix.foundBy: the first real sandbox buyer sign-in on the PR #21 images
callbackFix.cause: clearing the one-time state cookie through ResponseEntity replaced the session cookie the container had just set, so the browser returned signed out
callbackFix.fix: PR #22 appends the state-cookie cleanup to the servlet response
callbackFix.regressionTest: PayPalSignInTest.theReturnPreservesTheSessionCookieWhenClearingTheStateCookie, failing before the fix and passing after

signInTest.provider: PayPal sandbox, an existing sandbox personal buyer

acceptance.plan: $1,400 prepared and left unapproved; no PayPal order was created

spotCheck.afterDeployment: read-only checks from outside the cluster after the rollout
spotCheck.startRedirect: https://www.sandbox.paypal.com/signin/authorize with this site's return URL, scope openid profile email and a 256-bit state

scope: Sign-in used PayPal's sandbox with a sandbox personal buyer; no live PayPal account was involved
The acceptance run stopped at the prepared plan; the payment journey itself is recorded in 2026-10-28.sandbox.json
Payments are still decided by AgentSafe's local test authority; the catalog and venue are simulated
pending: Hosted Decionis enforcement, signed grants and Presence approval/resume
Live sandbox refusal, expiry, duplicate-webhook and ambiguous-response cases
Tents checkout through the PayPal buttons in the UI
